title: The Harvest Edit — Autumn Seasonal POS Kit

campaign.objective: Drive trial of the seasonal Harvest range and Meridian+ member sign-ups across 240 stores.
campaign.audience: Existing weekly shoppers, 28–55, quality-led, time-poor; skews toward members and lapsed members.

formats.name: gondola-header
formats.notes: Hangs above the bay; headline must read from 5 m.

formats.name: shelf-strip
formats.notes: Shelf-edge strip ~180×26 mm; extreme aspect ratio; price-led, minimal copy.

formats.name: aisle-fin
formats.notes: Protrudes into aisle; arrow-shaped die cut; needs a CutContour cut path.

formats.name: wobbler
formats.notes: Round die-cut wobbler ~A5; circular cut contour.

formats.name: dump-bin-wrap
formats.notes: Wraparound for the promo dump bin; very wide; copy repeats around corners.

copy.headline: THE HARVEST EDIT
copy.subhead: Seasonal flavour, picked at its peak
body: Our growers' best of the season — squash, plums, cobnuts and slow-ripened tomatoes, in store now.
Member price unlocked at the shelf. Scan to add this week's Harvest recipes to your basket.
copy.strapline: Tastes like the turn of the season.
copy.legal: *Member price requires a free Meridian+ account. £3.50 saving vs. non-member price on selected lines until 31/10/26, while stocks last. Origin & allergen information at meridianmarket.co.uk/harvest. ©2026 Meridian Market Ltd. T&Cs apply.

references.moodboard: Farmers'-market warmth meets editorial restraint: deep plum and rust grounds, generous negative space, one confident food hero per piece, copper foil accent on premium touchpoints.
references.avoid: No cluttered starbursts, no rainbow gradients, no stock 'autumn leaves' clip-art, no drop shadows on type.

tone: Warm, premium, confident. Editorial grocer — think a good Saturday market stall art-directed by a magazine. Generous colour blocking, strong type hierarchy, never shouty.

creativeDirection.hierarchy: Headline → food hero → price/member hook → recipe QR → legal. Headline and price must dominate; legal is quiet but present.
creativeDirection.colour: Ground each piece in HarvestPlum or photography; OrchardRust and GoldenOchre for energy; CopperSpot reserved for the logo lockup and price flash on premium pieces; SageMist sparingly.
creativeDirection.logo: meridian-logo on light grounds, meridian-logo-reversed on plum/photography. Respect clear space; never below the minimum width.
creativeDirection.accessibility: Body and legal must clear the 4.0 contrast floor; minimum type size 7 pt; keep all copy inside the safe zone.

production.process: Litho + spot CopperSpot on header/poster; digital for short-run fins/wobblers.
production.finish: Die-cut shaped pieces use the CutContour spot as the cutter guide (kiss-cut on wobbler).

notes: This is a deliberately maximal brief used to flush out gaps and edge cases across the pipeline. Generate the MASTER format (gondola-header) now; the rest of the kit is the intended variant set (BRF-2 / VAR-1).
